keys.key: No accounts to create. No server that can read your vault. No subscription holding your data hostage. Just your iPhone, your keys, your secrets.
keys.en: No accounts to create. No server that can read your vault. No subscription holding your data hostage. Just your iPhone, your keys, your secrets.
keys.vi: Không cần tạo tài khoản. Không máy chủ nào đọc được kho của bạn. Không gói thuê bao nào giữ dữ liệu của bạn làm con tin. Chỉ có iPhone của bạn, chìa khóa của bạn, bí mật của bạn.
keys.ja: 作るアカウントはありません。あなたの保管庫を読めるサーバーもありません。データを人質に取るサブスクもありません。あるのはあなたの iPhone、あなたの鍵、あなたの秘密だけです。
keys.context: About: refusal block secondary paragraph. Replaces the retired "No servers holding your vault" line, which iCloud sync contradicts (Apple holds the ciphertext).

keys.key: Every item is sealed with AES-256 before it touches storage. If it ever leaves your iPhone, to iCloud, to another device, it leaves already locked. We couldn't read it if we wanted to. Nobody can.
keys.en: Every item is sealed with AES-256 before it touches storage. If it ever leaves your iPhone, to iCloud, to another device, it leaves already locked. We couldn't read it if we wanted to. Nobody can.
keys.vi: Mọi mục đều được niêm phong bằng AES-256 trước khi được lưu trữ. Nếu dữ liệu rời iPhone của bạn, lên iCloud, sang thiết bị khác, nó rời đi trong trạng thái đã khóa. Chúng tôi muốn đọc cũng không được. Không ai đọc được.
keys.ja: すべての項目は保存される前に AES-256 で封じられます。iPhone を離れて iCloud や別のデバイスへ渡るときも、施錠されたまま出ていきます。私たちが読みたくても読めません。誰にも読めません。
keys.context: About: promise 1 body. Replaces "Everything is sealed…", which folder icon, colour and sort order (plaintext in CloudKit) contradict.

keys.key: Only you can read your vault
keys.en: Only you can read your vault
keys.vi: Chỉ bạn đọc được kho của mình
keys.ja: 保管庫を読めるのはあなただけ
keys.context: About: title of the fourth "How your data is protected" row. Replaces the retired "Zero backend".

keys.key: Some features do use the network: iCloud sync, sharing links, breach checks, website icons, subscriptions and crash diagnostics. Your vault is sealed before any of them, so it stays readable only on your devices.
keys.en: Some features do use the network: iCloud sync, sharing links, breach checks, website icons, subscriptions and crash diagnostics. Your vault is sealed before any of them, so it stays readable only on your devices.
keys.vi: Một số tính năng có dùng mạng: đồng bộ iCloud, liên kết chia sẻ, kiểm tra rò rỉ, biểu tượng trang web, gói thuê bao và báo cáo sự cố. Kho của bạn được niêm phong trước khi bất kỳ tính năng nào chạy, nên chỉ đọc được trên thiết bị của bạn.
keys.ja: ネットワークを使う機能もあります。iCloud 同期、共有リンク、漏洩チェック、サイトアイコン、サブスク、クラッシュ診断です。保管庫はその前に封じられるため、読めるのはあなたのデバイスの中だけです。
keys.context: About: detail of the fourth "How your data is protected" row. Replaces "Nothing is sent to a server…", which CloudKit, Loox Link, Quick View, the relay, the entitlement service and the favicon fetch all contradict.

keys.key: Analytics stay off unless you turn them on. Crash diagnostics are on so faults can be found and fixed, and you can turn them off in Settings. There are no accounts.
keys.en: Analytics stay off unless you turn them on. Crash diagnostics are on so faults can be found and fixed, and you can turn them off in Settings. There are no accounts.
keys.vi: Dữ liệu phân tích luôn tắt trừ khi bạn bật lên. Báo cáo sự cố đang bật để lỗi được tìm ra và sửa, và bạn có thể tắt trong Cài đặt. Không có tài khoản nào.
keys.ja: 分析はオンにしない限りオフのままです。不具合を見つけて直せるようクラッシュ診断はオンですが、設定でオフにできます。アカウントはありません。
keys.context: About: privacy card. States the shipping defaults (analytics opt-in, crash diagnostics opt-out). Replaces the false "Loox collects no analytics and has no accounts…".

reused: Uses k-anonymity. Only the first five characters of each password's SHA-1 hash are sent. Passwords never leave your device.
retired: Loox collects no analytics and has no accounts. The only network request is the optional, anonymised breach check.
Nothing is sent to a server. Your vault never leaves the device unencrypted.
No accounts to create. No servers holding your vault. No subscription holding your data hostage. Just your iPhone, your keys, your secrets.
Everything is sealed with AES-256 before it touches storage. If it ever leaves your iPhone, to iCloud, to another device, it leaves already locked. We couldn't read it if we wanted to. Nobody can.
notes: `reused` keys already carry EN + VI + JA in the catalog and need no merge action. `retired` keys are no longer referenced by any source file and can be pruned from the catalog; leaving them in is harmless but they are dead weight and two of them are false claims that must never render again.
